breaks.php: Never returns. wp_kses_split2() repeats wp_kses() on a comment's text until it stops changing; `</<i>` becomes `</<i>>` and every later pass adds another `>`, so the loop runs until PHP's time or memory limit.
breaks.port: Gives a comment or invalid-markup token at most 16 passes to settle and drops the token when it has not. Every corpus input settles within 2 passes.
breaks.reason: No input may make kses do runaway work (design: Security). A post containing `<!--</<i>` would otherwise pin a server worker forever.
breaks.why: No input may make kses do runaway work (design: Security). A post containing `<!--</<i>` would otherwise pin a server worker forever.

breaks.php: Throws TypeError: wp_kses_attr() passes a tag's value to array_filter() whenever it is neither empty() nor true, so a non-array value crashes the request.
breaks.port: Keeps the tag with every attribute denied, as kses treats any other non-array value.
breaks.why: A malformed allowlist entry should not crash kses; the port's output is the safest reading (no attributes).
